name: Williams Funeral Home
notes: Interpretation (no reference image): a two-story Greek Revival house in white-painted brick under a slate hip roof, with a full-height four-column portico and pediment, black shutters on 6-over-6 windows, lanterns, a small balcony over the entry, a one-story chapel wing on the left, a porte-cochere and garage on the right and a rear ell. No signs. Front faces Main Street; the building sits back from the curb as the Atlas footprint does.
